critical_code_review_comments: landing.info_request: when repeated=True the request is still inserted with call_status='repetida' and no email notification is sent (good: avoids spamming admin). Verified by second doc appearing with repetida status after repeat POST.

Legal.jsx exports COMPANY which Chrome.jsx imports — tight coupling via @/pages/Legal; acceptable for current size but if legal pages grow, consider a dedicated /src/content/company.js module to keep Chrome independent of pages.

Chrome.jsx Footer renders Sectors list from SEO_PAGES filtered by market; with 11 sectors the single sm:grid-cols-3 column renders a 11-item list — long but functional. Consider column-count or two-column list for readability.
InfoForm.jsx: repeat note is a sibling of the

sector_demo.build is still called inline during first HTTP request for new slugs; the 4 new slugs x 2 countries generated audio on first test request (took ~15–20s each, now cached). Pre-warming at startup for all slugs would avoid user-facing cold latency.

Legal.jsx uses document.title directly in useEffect — Seo component isn't invoked for legal pages. OK since legal pages don't need JSON-LD/OG, but the hard-coded 'octubre de 2026' date should be data-driven or current.
Footer paddingBottom pb-24 md:pb-0 is to offset MobileCta on landing pages — on legal pages (no MobileCta) the extra 96px bottom padding still applies on mobile. Minor cosmetic.
